Name: Timnah in Dan
Description: The Timnah of Samson's story, where he saw a Philistine woman and where the men of Judah later bound him; named in both Judah's and Dan's allotment lists on their shared border.
BiblicalSignificance: Timnah in Dan is Samson's town, where his riddle and his first confrontations with the Philistines unfolded.
KeyScriptures: Joshua 15:10; Joshua 19:43; Judges 14:1-2; Judges 14:5; Judges 15:6; 2 Chronicles 28:18
